observations: body L2, L3: «قُبَّة» (L2) and «الأَرْض» (L3) have no vowel sign on their last letters; «القُبَّةُ» (L2) is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.
body L5: «السِّكِّينِ» has the shadda alone over the sīn and the kāf, with the kasras below them; the kasra under the final nūn stands 5.6 points below the baseline.
body L6: «مُقَابِلَ» has a fatḥa on its final lām; «ومُدْبِرَة» has no vowel sign on the wāw.
body L7: «٢٦{13, 17}» is a 2 with one crest and a 6 flush with it (5.8 points), as «٢٦٠» on p. 345.

body L17: the denominator of the second fraction is printed closed on the left, like an 8 (it is filled except for a small hole in the lower bowl); read as the 3 of 6 2/3, the value of I, 182, where one of the two printed 3s has the same closed form.
body L19, L22: «الذِّرَاعَيْن» has no vowel sign on its final nūn; «اِقْتِرَانٌ» has the kasra under the alif and the sukun on the qāf.
body L24: «بِنِصفينِ» has kasras under the bāʾ, the first nūn and the final nūn and no vowel sign above. «٢٧{13}» has a 2 with one crest (the 27 is 7.0 points wide), «٣٥» and «٣٦» 3s with two crests.
body L25: the second letter of «ونقسمها» has one dot above (nūn). «أَرْبَاعًا» has a second fatḥa over the alif after the bāʾ, not transcribed, and is printed with a kashīda.
body L26: «الخطّيْن» has the shadda alone on the ṭāʾ, the sukun on the yāʾ and no vowel sign on the khāʾ.
body L29: «٣٢ quinquies»: the left digit is 5.0 points wide with two crests (a 3), the right one 3.0 points with one crest (a 2); their stems stand at x 138.5 and 143.4.
body L31: «١٨{1}» has two digits (6.2 points).
body L35: «قطع» is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.
body L7, L21: «ἡ» has the rough breathing, as «ἡ» in notes_right L1; «ἀκρόνυκτος» there has the smooth one.
